edges.label: Standing DoD denial: AARO has not discovered any verifiable information
edges.note: Issued 7 June 2023, two days after The Debrief, and recycled since. Signatory: Susan Gough, DoD spokesperson. Note the boundary of the sentence: it asserts what one office has discovered, not what exists, and is silent on holdings outside AARO's access.

title: Fox News - Pentagon denies secret UFO retrieval program after whistleblower bombshell
